caption:
Nvidia stock rose after earnings: fiscal Q3 sales hit a record $115.8B, about $7B above the $108.8B Wall Street expected, and the Q4 guide of $130B beat the $125.3B forecast. Shares rose 3.7% after hours, yet closed Tuesday at $155.46, 36% under their 52-week high.
The guide assumes zero China data-centre compute revenue, and gross margin is guided to 71-72% from 74.9%.

Sources: Nvidia Q3 FY2027 results (Nov 17, 2026), BigGo Finance (estimates, Nov 17), Yahoo Finance (after-hours prices, Nov 17), The Motley Fool (close and 52-week range, Nov 17), Nasdaq (last year's Q4 report date). Not investment advice.
